$comment: Shared token runs found by scripts/similarity-audit.mjs and reviewed by hand. Each entry matches a run by file and a fragment of its first tokens. See docs/PROVENANCE.md.

reviewed.reason: Zabbix widget view API: every widget view builds a CWidgetView, adds its container and calls show(). Our container, classes and variables differ.
Zabbix time period field API: the documented way to default a widget's time period to the dashboard's (CWidgetField::createTypedReference with REFERENCE_DASHBOARD and DATA_TYPE_TIME_PERIOD).
Test fixture object literal (item id, host, units, value). The shape follows the Zabbix item fields both projects read, not code.
